summary: Iteration 233 — Katrina (كاترينا) L16 assistant validation. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed. Frontend: 9/10 Playwright steps passed (the 10th is a timing/selector artifact, not a product bug — see below). All five complaints from the user are RESOLVED: (1) write-intent commands now EXECUTE (mode=action, executed.status=committed/duplicate, reply '✅ **تم بنجاح**'); (2) hamza/article/kunya tolerant search returns 'ابو مصري' for all three query variants; (3) model badge displays '⚡ Sonnet' (default='sonnet', label='Claude Sonnet 4.6'); (4) mobile drawer height = 0.800 of viewport (exactly ~80vh); (5) voice toggle + mic button render. Pure question routes through read-path (mode=normal, firewall.health_score in tool_results). Risky delete returns mode=action, status=pending_approval with ApprovalCard. Header title is 'كاترينا'. Close button + mobile handle both close the drawer and FAB reappears.

minor.issue: Duplicate-prevention message is '⚠️ **عميل موجود مسبقاً** — ...' but executed.status is not explicitly 'duplicate'/'deduped' — clients have to parse the response text. Consider returning executed.status='duplicate' (or status='committed' with a dedup_reason field) for easier UX.

Response envelope is {success, tool, agent, result:{...}, write} — DIFFERENT from /api/assistant/chat which uses {success, data:{...}}. Inconsistent. Recommend unifying both to {success, data} for client simplicity.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end timing on the public preview can exceed 15s for the assistant bubble to render '✅ تم بنجاح' after clicking send. The execution itself works (verified via 'Executed Operations' panel showing 3 committed entries: مركبة 7788, عميل تجريبي ٢, عميل خالد المطيري) — but the visible bubble may take 20-30s on first LLM call. Consider showing a streaming-style progress message or extending the in-flight indicator until the bubble lands.

issues: Top-bar uses purple gradient — readable but high saturation; bot avatar + 'كاترينا' RTL aligned correctly.

Main dashboard area kept showing a loading spinner while assistant drawer was open — dashboard widgets did not finish loading within the test window. Possibly unrelated to this iteration but worth checking RecentOperationsWidget (also threw a React validateDOMNesting warning: <button> nested inside <button>).

action_items: CLEANUP (Supabase): delete the test customers/vehicles created during this iteration — see seed_data_creation below for the exact IDs.

OPTIONAL: standardize the response envelope between /api/assistant/chat (uses {success,data:{...}}) and /api/assistant/tool/* (uses {success,tool,result:{...}}) — current inconsistency forces clients to branch on path.

OPTIONAL: expose executed.status='duplicate' (or executed.duplicate=true) when create_customer is short-circuited by the existing-customer guard, so the frontend can render a distinct UI without parsing Arabic text.
critical_code_review_comments: looks_like_action() / _build_action_chat_response() correctly routed all three write-intent phrasings (classical 'سجل', dialect 'ابغى اضيف', 'ضيف') to unified_executor — dialect support works without relying on the frontend's brittle regex.

arabic_match() correctly normalised hamza ('أ'→'ا'), removed the definite article 'ال' before 'مصري', and matched on token overlap so all of {'ابو مصري','ابو المصري','أبو المصري'} retrieved the same row.

The chat envelope {success, data:{...}} is now consistent for chat, but the tool-execution endpoint /api/assistant/tool/* still returns {success, tool, agent, result:{...}, write} — recommend aligning both to reduce client branching.
Frontend AssistantProvider dispatches 'finance:updated' on data.executed.status=='committed' — verified in console: 💰 Finance updated: assistant fired after the desktop close-button step.
Mobile drawer measured height ratio = 0.800 of viewport (390x844) — exactly matches the 80vh spec.

Voice & mic buttons render under data-testid='assistant-voice-toggle' and data-testid='assistant-mic-btn'. Actual STT/TTS could not be exercised in headless chromium — recommend manual verification on a real device.

Risky delete: GET status pending_approval and an ApprovalCard is emitted — but the payload contains operation 'رقم 123' which likely does not exist; ensure the approval card carries operation_id resolved from context, not just the user-typed string.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 — 1 timing artifact, not a product bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 user complaints from this iteration are verified resolved on backend (10/10 pytest) and frontend (9/10 Playwright; the 10th step is a timing artifact — the executed-operations panel proves the flow works end-to-end). rca of the issue: All 5 reported user complaints (instructions-vs-execution, kunya/hamza search, GPT badge, mobile sizing, voice/mic) are RESOLVED end-to-end. The single observed regression candidate is phone-number capture on the classical 'سجل عميل اسمه X جواله NNN' phrasing (got 0000000000 instead of the digits). Reproduction: POST /api/assistant/chat {message:'سجل عميل اسمه فلان فلان جواله 05XXXXXXXX', model:'sonnet', proposer:'مدير'} → executed.result.phone may default to 0000000000. Compare with the dialect phrasing which captures correctly. Mitigation: revisit the phone-extraction regex in unified_executor / NLP layer to ensure 'جواله 05XX' is parsed identically to 'جواله 05XX' in the dialect path.
